Welcome to the ASMR Massage Physioline channel! It was founded in 2022 by Physiotherapy Technicians Tahir, Sedef and Yakup.We offer neck massage,shoulder massage,back massage,waist massage,leg massage,foot massage,cup therapy, graston,stretcher and chair massage.Don't forget to subscribe, like and comment your thoughts!

NOTE: Please note that our massages are for relaxation purposes only.

Copyright Notice:

All content on this YouTube channel is protected by copyright law. Unauthorized use, duplication or use of the content on other platforms is prohibited.

For appointment and cooperation, you can contact us at +905349545647. Thank you for being part of our community!
